title: Epoxy resin composition containing core-shell polymer, cured product of the same and method for its preparation
abstract: A core-shell polymer-containing epoxy resin composition, wherein the composition comprises 100 parts by weight of epoxy resin (A), 1 to 100 parts by weight of core-shell polymer (B), and 1 at 80 parts by weight of a curing agent, the core-shell polymer has a volume average particle diameter of 0.01 to 1 μm, the core part of the core-shell polymer (B) has the temperature of glass transition less than 0 ° C, the shell part of the core-shell polymer (B) has the glass transition temperature less than 25 ° C, and the shell part of the core-shell polymer (B) is polymerized with al minus one monomer that has an epoxy group.
